## Manual webhook setup
Create a **BattleMetrics Webhook** credential with a high-entropy shared secret. Start listening and copy the Test URL, or activate this workflow and copy the Production URL. In BattleMetrics, add a Webhook action to a harmless personal trigger, paste the URL, enter the same secret, select JSON, and use a documented synthetic template. BattleMetrics setup is manual; never put the secret in the URL or body.
